Essilor® Stellest® lenses for Myopia

Book AppointmentCall: (732) 978-9306

If your child’s prescription keeps changing, you’re probably wondering what you can do to stay ahead of it. Myopia is common in kids, and it often progresses over time, but there are ways to help slow it down. Stellest® lenses are designed to do just that, offering a simple, research-backed option that fits easily into your child’s daily routine.

What Makes Stellest® Lenses Different

Stellest® lenses are designed specifically for myopia management, not just vision correction. While standard glasses help your child see clearly, Stellest® lenses are built with advanced technology that helps slow the rate at which their prescription changes. It’s a way to support your child’s vision while also thinking about their long-term eye health.

Book AppointmentCall: (732) 978-9306

The Importance of Slowing Myopia Progression

When myopia continues to progress, prescriptions can become stronger over time, and that can increase the risk of eye health issues later in life.

The goal of myopia management is to slow that progression early, while your child’s eyes are still developing. Starting sooner can make a meaningful difference down the road.

Call: (732) 978-9306

How Stellest® lenses Help Manage Myopia

Stellest® lenses work by adjusting how light enters the eye. This helps slow the eye’s growth, which is what leads to worsening myopia. The best part is, your child wears them just like regular glasses, no extra steps and no complicated routines.

Book Appointment

Why Parents Choose Stellest® Lenses

Stellest® lenses are designed to fit easily into your child’s daily routine while supporting their long-term vision:

  • Worn just like regular prescription glasses
  • Comfortable for school, activities, and everyday wear
  • Helps slow changes in your child’s prescription
  • Backed by advanced myopia control lens technology

Schedule a Myopia Consultation

If your child’s vision has been changing, it’s worth asking our eye doctors about Stellest® lenses. We’ll take the time to answer your questions, explain your options, and help you decide what makes the most sense moving forward.
